<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/process-paths/{id}/capacity"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Loads the ProcessPath identified by id, loads each of its steps' ProcessCapacity for the given location and window (matched by COVERAGE, see below), normalizes each step's effective rate into ORDER/period via the WorkloadProfile factors supplied on the request (Phase 2 simplification: there is no dedicated WorkloadProfile persistence yet), and returns the minimum normalized rate plus which step is the bottleneck.
Each step's candidate constraints are (a) the constraints of the ProcessCapacity aggregates of (process, location) whose window COVERS [window_start, window_end) -- registered window start &lt; window_start AND registered window end >= window_end, so an equal window covers it -- taking, per constraint type, the one from the covering window with the LATEST start (tie: the narrower window); older or wider covering windows' constraints of the same type are shadowed, other types still apply (docs/adr/0003), and (b) a DERIVED STATION constraint = the stations facility-layout tallied across the zones of the site (zone ids starting with `<location>-`) x the declared StationStandard, when both a station count above zero and a standard exist. EVERY candidate is normalized to ORDER/hour before the minimum is taken. With stations but no declared standard the step uses (a) only and `warnings` says so. `step_breakdown` and `warnings` are additive fields.
